description:
A mysterious Chinese businesswoman reportedly gained remarkable access to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang—even persuading him to show up at a late-night gathering in Taipei.

Now, a New York Times investigation has raised serious questions about her alleged intelligence connections, her business dealings, and billions of dollars in Nvidia AI chips.

The woman, identified as Alice Huang, was linked to Megaspeed, a Singapore-based company that reportedly purchased approximately $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia equipment. But questions have emerged about the company's ownership, financing, and the ultimate location of its advanced AI chips.

How did a relatively obscure company become one of Nvidia's biggest customers in Southeast Asia? What were its connections to Chinese investors and data centers? And what did American intelligence officials know about the woman who had access to Nvidia's CEO?
